name: ListImages

parameters.help_en: The image name. Fuzzy match is supported

parameters.help_en: The page number of the image list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 镜像列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The sort field for a paged query. Currently, the GmtCreateTime field is used for sorting
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的排序字段。目前GmtCreateTime字段用于排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order for the specified sort field in a paged query. Used together with SortBy. Default value: ASC.
ASC: Ascending order.
DESC: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序，与SortBy结合使用。默认ASC。
ASC：升序。
DESC：降序

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the image. Currently only takes effect for custom images.

PUBLIC: Public.
PRIVATE: Private
parameters.help_zh:
镜像的可见性，目前只对自定义镜像生效。

The visibility of the image. Valid values:
PUBLIC: All members of the current workspace can operate on the image.
PRIVATE: Only the creator can operate on the image

镜像的可见性，可能值：
PUBLIC：当前工作空间所有成员都可以操作。
PRIVATE：只有创建者可以操作
